map.修剪遵循三分之一原则：单次剪去量不超过草高的三分之一，留茬高度按草种取值（早熟禾: Mowing follows the one-third rule: never remove more than a third of the grass height in one pass, and the stubble height is set by grass type (Kentucky bluegrass 5 to 8 cm, Zoysia 2.5 to 5 cm, tall fescue 6 to 9 cm); mow every 5 to 7 days in the growing season and stretch that to every 2 to 4 weeks in dormancy; leaving the lawn a little taller in summer improves drought and disease tolerance.

map.：每次修剪变换方向，避免草向一侧倾斜: : change direction each time so the grass does not lean to one side

map.按季节调整：夏季适当留高护根、冬季留高防寒、春秋生长季勤剪促分蘖。: Adjust by season: leave it taller in summer to protect roots, taller in winter for cold protection, and mow often in the spring and autumn growing seasons to encourage tillering.
map.留茬高度（春/夏/秋/冬，cm）: Stubble height (spring / summer / autumn / winter, cm)
map.狗牙根 3/4/3/5；结缕草 3/4/3/5；高羊茅 5/6/5/6；圣奥古斯: Bermudagrass 3/4/3/5; Zoysia 3/4/3/5; tall fescue 5/6/5/6; St. Augustinegrass 5/6/5/7; centipedegrass 5/6/5/7; ryegrass 4/5/4/5; Kentucky bluegrass 4/5/4/5; Stowaway 4/4/4/5. Seasonal notes: mow once a week in the spring growth peak to encourage tillering; in summer heat leave it 1-2 cm taller to protect roots and reduce watering; in autumn mow every 10 days to build reserves for winter; in winter dormancy mow less and leave it taller for cold protection.
map.高羊茅草坪夏季草长到 8 cm、目标留茬 6 cm：一次剪去 2 cm，占 8: A tall fescue lawn at 8 cm in summer with a 6 cm target stubble: removing 2 cm in one pass is 25% of 8 cm, which satisfies the 1/3 rule and can be done in one mowing. If it has already grown to 12 cm with a 6 cm target, cutting 6 cm exceeds 1/3, so it should be lowered gradually in two passes several days apart, otherwise large areas will yellow.
map.一次剪去过多叶片会大量损失光合面积、削弱根系，草坪发黄甚至死亡；分次逐步降低可让: Removing too much leaf area in one pass loses a lot of photosynthetic surface and weakens the roots, so the lawn yellows and can even die; lowering the height in stages lets the lawn adapt and recover.
map.夏季为什么要留高一些？: Why leave it taller in summer?
map.较高的草层能遮阴土壤、降低地温、减少水分蒸发并抑制杂草萌发，帮助冷季型或暖季型草: A taller sward shades the soil, lowers ground temperature, reduces water evaporation and suppresses weed germination, helping both cool-season and warm-season lawns get through heat stress.
